facts.fact: 2024-09-28 男主第一次以第一人称写日记，自述高中后没再写过日记
facts.anchor: I haven’t kept a diary since I was in high school.

facts.fact: 他刚搬进 Kirkhill，位于约克郡荒原深处
facts.anchor: I’ve just moved into a new place, Kirkhill, deep in the heart of the Yorkshire moors.

facts.fact: 他整理的调查成果：Arthur 与 Caroline 2011 年搬入 Kirkhill，2020 年搬走
facts.anchor: Moved into Kirkhill in 2011, moved out sometime in 2020.

facts.fact: 慈善店女人说 Caroline 捐过衣服和摆件
facts.anchor: she’d told him about Caroline’s donations

facts.fact: Caroline 2019-08-09 日记：她有时希望 Arthur 死掉，好让她好好哀悼他
facts.anchor: I sometimes wish that he would die, so I could mourn him properly.

facts.fact: 入夜他听见电线嗡鸣如千声低语
facts.anchor: the hum of the wires; the sound of a thousand voices whispering from overhead

facts.fact: 他把电线嗡鸣听成「空神的声音」，今晚却觉得安慰
facts.anchor: All of life twisted into a cable that hummed like the voice of an empty god.

facts.fact: 他随机翻开一本书，发现是 Arthur 在读的《The Lightning Chasers》，Arthur 在日记里用大写字母写书名
facts.anchor: The title was The Lightning Chasers, by Adrian Warner.
